passages.text: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
passages.note: Overwhelm from carrying others' burdens alone

passages.text: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s.
passages.note: Fairness; not fearing others' opinion when deciding

passages.text: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
passages.note: Looking back on long hardship with gratitude
